necessary_context.content: For d-dimensional inputs and delta>0, u is uniform on the Euclidean unit sphere. Both values are of the same function f: gtilde=d[f(w+delta u)-f(w-delta u)]u/(2 delta). Query access may need to extend outside W.

necessary_context.content: Theorem 1 assumes convex f_t that is G2-Lipschitz in Euclidean norm and a dual norm satisfying (E||u||_*^4)^(1/4)<=p_*<infinity. For the selected second-moment assertion the expectation is over the fresh direction for a fixed function, center and radius.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.4, Theorem 1 assumptions 2–3; pp.7–8, Lemma 10 second-moment Proof
necessary_context.name: Lipschitz and norm parameters

necessary_context.content: Lemma 9 states that an L-Lipschitz function h on the Euclidean sphere satisfies sqrt(E[(h(u)-Eh(u))^4])<=C L^2/d. Its Proof uses a sphere concentration tail, attributed there to Ledoux (2005), then integrates the tail. The cited Ledoux original was not read in this job.
necessary_context.name: Fourth-moment dependency
